initial_analysis:
This is a classic Imperial efficiency vs Rebel durability matchup. We have 3 ships (19 total hull/shields) against their 3 ships (25 total hull/shields). The enemy has two I6 pilots (Han and Wedge) which ties our Vader for initiative - this is a key consideration for repositioning. 

Key observations:
- Vader's Defender chassis (3 agility + white evade) makes him extremely survivable against their 3-dice attacks
- Chiraneau's 12H/4S is a massive health pool but 0 agility makes him vulnerable to focused fire
- Han's rerolls and 360-degree arc make him a consistent damage dealer that's hard to flank
- Wedge's pilot ability (reduces defender's agility by 1) is DEVASTATING against Vader - drops him to 2 agility
- Luke with Servomotor S-Foils Open gains boost, making him slippery
- Wedge has S-Foils Closed (gains focus-to-evade but loses boost) - he's in defensive configuration

Their squad has excellent synergy: Wedge strips agility, Han rerolls consistently, Luke can close in with boost. However, they lack repositioning at I6 (Wedge closed S-foils = no boost) which Vader can exploit.
my_squad_strengths: Vader's repositioning and survivability against non-Wedge attacks
Chiraneau's massive health pool can absorb significant damage
Gideon's bonus attack die against damaged ships rewards focus fire
Higher overall maneuverability - Defender and TIE vs X-wings and YT-1300
Vader ties I6 with Han/Wedge - can choose to move before or after
my_squad_weaknesses: Chiraneau's 0 agility makes him melt under focused fire
Gideon is fragile at 3H/0S - one bad engagement and he's gone
We have fewer total hit points (19 vs 25)
If Chiraneau dies early, we lose our damage anchor
enemy_threats: Wedge Antilles - PRIORITY THREAT: His -1 agility ability neutralizes Vader's main defense. Must die first or be avoided
Han Solo - Consistent damage with rerolls, 360 arc means he always has a shot. His health pool makes him a late-game problem
Luke Skywalker - Force charges for repositioning/mods, boost from open S-foils makes him mobile. Can finish off wounded ships

ship_roles.darth_vader: ace - Use superior repositioning to arc-dodge and hunt Wedge. Stay away from Wedge's arc at all costs. Leverage full stop and boost/barrel roll to control engagement
ship_roles.rear_admiral_chiraneau: anchor - Draw fire and deal consistent damage. Use reinforce to mitigate incoming damage. Position to force difficult choices on enemy
ship_roles.gideon_hask: flanker - Stay at range 3 or behind rocks. Look for opportunistic shots on damaged ships. His ability triggers on damaged enemies so coordinate with Chiraneau's damage output

opponent_tendencies: Unknown - observing. Watch for: Do they joust or flank? Do they focus Vader or Chiraneau? Does Han hang back or engage?
